decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0700  to  1700  on Mondays to Friday and 0800  to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The erection of a rear dormer roof extension, as shown on drawing number 0285 - 01 received 12 September 2005 and, 02 A, 03 A, 05 A and 06 A received 31 October 2005, is considered acceptable as the proposed development would not harm the appearance of the existing building or unduly reduce the existing amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations.
description: Erection of roof extension to first floor flat to create additional bedroom and bathroom.
